purpose: Determine whether the public v4 modes and high-rate dynamics retain unmodified waveform samples on both sides of the NQC matching time. Call the pinned public API at 0.015625 M with nqcFlag=1 for coefficients and nqcFlag=0 for modes/dynamics. Infer the integer mode cut from the returned epoch and orbital-phase frequency peak, then compare the 22-mode amplitude peak to the source NQC match time. Returned modes already include ringdown and are not a direct pre-NQC input oracle.
